description: Write the flat's constitution before the first passive-aggressive note — money, chores, guests, noise, food, and the exit plan, decided while everyone still likes each other, in language that's firm without being corporate. Use when moving in with roommates, when the dishes cold-war has started, when a partner basically lives there rent-free, or when someone's moving out mid-lease.
